title: Combining Tanzania With Gorillas in Rwanda
excerpt: Combine a safari in Tanzania with mountain gorillas in Rwanda. How the route works and what to know about gorilla permits.
body:
## Mountain gorillas

Mountain gorillas live in Volcanoes National Park in Rwanda, and in Uganda and DR Congo. Tanzania has no gorillas.

## The route

Fly from Kilimanjaro or Dar es Salaam to Kigali, drive about two to three hours to Volcanoes National Park, trek, and return.

## Permits

Gorilla permits are expensive and limited per day. Book well in advance.

## The trek

Treks can take from one to several hours through steep, muddy forest. You spend one hour with the gorillas.

## Rules

Distance, masks when required, no visits when ill, minimum age.

## Combine

Rwanda first and then Tanzania's safari and beach, or the other way round.
